# Simplified Chinese installer translation

`ChineseSimplified.isl` is the unmodified Inno Setup 6.5.0+ translation by Zhenghan Yang (Kira), distributed under its upstream MIT license in `LICENSE`. Original maintainer notices are preserved in the translation file.

Upstream: https://github.com/kira-96/Inno-Setup-Chinese-Simplified-Translation

The file is included here so builds do not depend on which optional languages are installed with the compiler. The Inno Setup compiler is installed separately: https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php .
